top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §744.3501(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Posting of Emergency Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §744.405)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have the required important phone numbers posted or in a binder.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - Daily Menu, Including All Snacks and Meals Prepared or Served (26 TAC §744.401(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Menu was not posted during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements-Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram (26 TAC §744.401(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operation did not have emergency evacuation and relocation diagram posted.

top_violation_types.title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §744.303(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not report a change in director.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §744.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver didn't have their file available during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training-Required Topics in Health and Safety (26 TAC §744.1309(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver was missing the required annual training in the following topics: 1309(C),  1309 (D) (2), 1309 (D) (3), 1309 (D) (4).

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that child was left unattended, and caregiver was not at a physical proximity which did not allow visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.
